entities.name: Dragon War
entities.description: An event during the Time of Legends on Corondor triggered by the summoning of the last Scarzam dragon.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: The Swamp King who ordered the Date of Tribute and sought the last Scarzam dragon's power.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Summoner who charmed Sivitri's dragon to leave and swore revenge on Chondeah.

entities.name: Chondeah
entities.description: Summoner who secretly conspired against Sol'Kanar; her home of Shikar was allowed to shine.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Rider of the last Scarzam dragon who attacked Sol'Kanar for the poppies that killed her dragons.

entities.name: Sivitri's War
entities.description: War in which poppies killed all of Sivitri's dragons.

entities.name: Khone
entities.description: Gydolien's home, scoured on Sol'Kanar's order.

events.summary: Gydolien Mor and Chondeah summon the last Scarzam dragon with Sivitri Scarzam mounted on it.
events.quote: Gydolien Mor and Chondeah finally managed the feat, summoning the last Scarzam dragon.

events.summary: Sivitri attacks Sol'Kanar as the source of the poppies that killed her dragons.
Gydolien charms Sivitri's dragon, which leaves through the portal with Sivitri.
events.quote: Gydolien intervened by charming Sivitri's dragon, instructing it to leave.

events.summary: Sol'Kanar orders a scouring of Khone; Gydolien swears revenge on Chondeah.
events.quote: Gydolien Mor swore revenge upon Chondaeh.

relations.note: Blames him as the source of the poppies
relations.quote: Recognizing Sol'Kanar as the source of the poppies that had killed all her dragons in Sivitri's War
Gydolien Mor swore revenge upon Chondaeh.
